Privacy Policy

Updated 15 September 2026. This notice describes the information used by this website and its enquiry process. Contact Hack Your Skills at hello@hackyourskills.com with privacy questions.

Information you submit

The audit form asks for your name, email, website and offer. Traffic sources and goals are optional. The follow-up questions collect additional context and the email used for your request. An enquiry reference helps associate these submissions.

Purpose

We use this information to assess your request, prepare the requested audit and communicate about it or a project you ask us to discuss. Submitting the audit form does not subscribe you to a marketing list.

Form and booking services

The form sends your submission to Static Forms for processing and delivery. Meeting links open TidyCal, where you can review its privacy information before entering booking details. Website hosting also involves processing technical request information to serve and protect the site.

When your browser provides a recognised referring site, an audit submission may include a source category such as Google, ChatGPT or Perplexity. We do not attach the full referring URL or search query. This category can be missing or incomplete.

Browser storage

Your selected language is stored in your browser. Audit drafts and recent submission details are kept in session storage to preserve your work during language switching and connect the optional follow-up. These entries expire in the website logic after 24 hours and are normally removed when the tab session ends. No form contents are included in the website’s conversion-event hooks.

Your privacy request

You can ask about your information, request a correction or ask for deletion by emailing hello@hackyourskills.com. We may need to verify that the request concerns your information. You can also raise a concern with the Dutch Data Protection Authority.
